config_dir.description: Directory to change into before starting work (equivalent to `-C dir`). If empty, current directory is used.

files.description: Number of 1 GiB files to write. If 0 or omitted, fill until disk is full.

skip_verify.description: Skip verification of written files (e.g., for disk wiping). Corresponds to `-N`.

only_verify.description: Only verify existing data files using the provided random seed. Corresponds to `-r`.

repeats.description: Number of times to repeat the fill/test/wipe steps. Seed is not changed between repetitions. Corresponds to `-R`.

seed.description: Random seed for generating pseudo-random data. If 0, seed may be system-determined or vary per run unless explicitly set.

size.description: Size of each random file in MiB. Default is 1024 (1 GiB). Corresponds to `-S`.

remove_after_success.description: Remove files after successful test. Corresponds to `-u`.

immediate_remove.description: Immediately remove files after writing, using file handles for verification. Corresponds to `-U`.
